entries.zh: 平民；常人、普通人（非士绅贵族出身者）
entries.en: a commoner; a plebeian; an ordinary person

entries.zh: 平常；普通、寻常（plebeyo 之形容词用）
entries.en: ordinary; common; usual

entries.zh: 匹夫；寻常男子、凡夫（贬用时指粗鄙之夫）
entries.en: an ordinary man; a common fellow (sometimes pejorative)
entries.notes: M 栏两音节声调标记均 T99（原件污损难辨），唯西语 plebeyo 与汉字「匹夫」互证尚明，故降为低置信。

entries.zh: 庸常；平凡无奇
entries.en: mediocre; commonplace; ordinary

entries.zh: 中缘人〔原件局部污损，「中缘」义未详，疑指身份居中的平常人或中人〕，释义存疑
entries.en: possibly a person of middling standing or a middleman 〔text damaged, sense uncertain〕
entries.notes: 「中緣」于闽南语汇罕见，末音节声调 T99 污损，与 plebeyo 之对应无法定夺。

entries.zh: 中品；中等品第、身份平常之人
entries.en: of middling rank; a person of common grade
entries.notes: 「品」音节声调 T99 污损；plebeyo 与「中品」互证尚明。

entries.zh: 刁；奸刁、刁滑难缠（状好讼刁滑之人）
entries.en: cunning; crafty; troublesome and given to quarrels (a litigious type)
entries.notes: 词头 Pleytita 疑为 pleitista（好讼者）之俗写，「刁」声调 T99 污损，对应关系存疑。

entries.zh: 口利；嘴利、言语尖利好争（状好讼之人）
entries.en: sharp-tongued; quick with contentious words; litigious
entries.notes: 两音节声调均 T99 污损；「口利」与词头 pleitita（疑即 pleitista 好讼者）义合。

entries.zh: 告；告状、控告
entries.en: to accuse; to sue; to lodge a complaint

entries.zh: 讼；诉讼、打官司（西语 pleito、demanda 并举）
entries.en: lawsuit; litigation; a legal dispute

entries.zh: 呈告；以书状呈递控告、书面兴讼
entries.en: to submit a written accusation; a plaint in writing (pleito por escrito)
entries.notes: 首音节声调 T99 污损；H 栏仅录「呈」而 M 栏为两音节「sia. cô.」，据同页「告=cô」补释为「呈告」。

entries.zh: 诬；诬枉、捏词控告（pleito falso 不实之讼）
entries.en: false accusation; to accuse falsely

entries.zh: 诬告；诬控、以不实之词兴讼
entries.en: false accusation; malicious prosecution; to sue falsely

entries.zh: 官事；官司、讼案、官府之事
entries.en: lawsuit; official or legal business
entries.notes: 两音节声调均 T99 污损；词头 pleito falso 与「官事」之搭配照录原文，按官事=官司释义。

entries.zh: 讦；讦发人短、攻讦告发〔M 栏附句大半污损难辨，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to denounce another's faults; to expose and accuse 〔remainder of the Hokkien gloss smudged, sense uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏九音节中六处 T99 污损，附例句无法可靠通读，仅据「讦」及首两音节「讦告」释义。

entries.zh: 官司；打官司、涉讼
entries.en: to litigate; to be engaged in a lawsuit
entries.notes: 两音节声调均 T99 污损；pleitear 与「官司」互证尚明。

entries.zh: 相告；互相控告、彼此兴讼
entries.en: to accuse one another; to sue each other

entries.zh: 讦告；讦发控告、告发人罪
entries.en: to denounce; to accuse by exposing another's faults
entries.notes: 首音节声调 T99 污损；「讦告」义据汉字自明。

entries.zh: 对主〔义未详，疑指与主人或讼事对方主事人当面对质〕，释义存疑
entries.en: possibly to face or answer one's master, or the opposing principal, in a dispute; sense uncertain
entries.notes: 「对主」与 pleitear 之对应于闽南语汇少见，两声调 T99 污损，义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 动手；动手斗殴、动武，亦指出手行事
entries.en: to come to blows; to use force; also, to set about an action
entries.notes: 两音节声调均 T99 污损；pleitear 取「争闹斗殴」俗义与「动手」相应。
